text.name: Esplender
text.description:
{Esplender}

This relic summons [SP/20] amounts of Ultraman-Gaia for the duration of a battle (summons will fail when Ultraman-Gaia has already in your army or less than 20 SP!!!!) and allow you to upgrade Ultraman-Agul Origine to Ultraman-Agul.In addition,this relic also allow Ultraman-Agul to cast mass Light of Ocean(dispel negative spell effect and +10% HP, +5 attack,+4 defence to ally every times.Accumulative) every turn on battle.
